versions.content: TDEventIPdu specifies events related to the exchange of I-PDUs The element TDEventIPdu is used to specify events, namely the exchange of I-PDUs, observable between the bus specific BSW modules (CANbus, FlexRay, LIN) and the AUTOSAR Com.
